biological_replicate.evidence: For global phosphoproteomics (biological duplicate), cells were labeled using stable isotope labeling with amino acids in cell culture (SILAC) (Invitrogen)42 according to manufacturer’s instructions.

experimental_design.evidence: inferred: To elucidate the mechanism of action (MoA) of ceritinib’s antiproliferative activity in these cells, we applied a systems approach combining both chemical and phosphoproteomics to gain a global view of ceritinib’s target profile and network-wide phosphorylation changes following ceritinib treatment.

factor_value.evidence: inferred: Log2 Fold Change values were calculated for both pY and pSTY (SILAC) datasets and student t-tests were performed for the pY dataset.
